messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] p99 latency SLO breach (streaming) for route /v1/stream/generate — p95 420ms -> 2.1s, p99 1.6s -> 8.3s. Tokenizer service CPU spikes and template-render queue depth rising.
oncall-sre-lauren: paging oncall. I'm on it. Raj can you look into tokenizer preproc? Omar, check prompt-template rollout.
eng-runtime-raj: looking. Seeing heavy sys CPU in tokenizer-0/1; preproc worker queue length has ~3x increase. Recent logs show lots of JSON_MODE=true requests with large tool schemas.
eng-ml-omar: saw a canary from earlier template change — added optional tool schema expansion in prompt builder. Reproducing locally shows template expansion exponential when nested tools present.
support-jules: FYI two customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: brewco) reported streaming stalls and truncated responses, support ticket numbers #5421 #5423.
oncall-sre-lauren: mitigation plan: 1) throttle/pause streaming routing to fallback route (non-streaming) 2) temporarily disable JSON_MODE expansion 3) scale tokenizer preproc pool + restart pods 4) rollback canary if needed. I'll execute in order.
oncall-sre-lauren: @deploy-bot scale tokenizer-preproc to 6 replicas
deploy-bot: Scaling deployment tokenizer-preproc from 2 -> 6 replicas (kubectl scale) — started.
eng-runtime-raj: increasing worker limiter: PATCH /config {"max_template_nodes":2000} to throttle expansion. applying now.
eng-ml-omar: disabling the canary flag in prompt-builder service: `POST /admin/flags {"prompt_tool_schema_expansion": false}` — applied.
oncall-sre-lauren: routing change: switching route /v1/stream/* to fallback non-streaming pool to reduce streaming tail pressure. Doing weighted shift 80/20 -> 0/100.
oncall-sre-lauren: /metrics query: rate(p99_latency[5m]) shows p99 falling from 8.3s -> 1.2s after scaling + flag change. p95 down to 320ms. Keep watching.
support-jules: customers updated: acme-inc moved to fallback and saw complete responses; brewco still seeing gaps — investigating sessions.
eng-runtime-raj: tokenizer pods restarted; worker queues normalized. However we saw one long-running template render traced to a nested tool schema with 42 entries — patching prompt renderer to short-circuit deep recursion.
product-amy: impact note for status page: brief degraded streaming for some users, non-streaming responses preserved. Recommend status: partial_degradation for streaming endpoints, update runbook.
oncall-sre-lauren: marking incident P2 -> will perform post-incident RCA. For now mitigation holds. Oncall handing to eng-runtime-raj for monitoring next 2 hours.
eng-runtime-raj: taking handoff — will keep watch, adding alert for template expansion rate > 1000/s and queue depth > 100.
eng-ml-omar: follow-up: create a test harness to simulate nested tool schemas and add regression test. Also propose a circuit-breaker in prompt-builder when schema size > 20.
oncall-sre-lauren: closing live mitigation thread. Please add notes to the incident doc and assign RCA owners: eng-runtime-raj (mitigation), eng-ml-omar (template fix), product-amy (customer comms). :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed for prompt-builder canary id cb-2026 — ok.
incident-bot: Incident update: p95/p99 improved; ticket created INC-2026. Next: RCA within 72h.
